results.name: Standalone file fresh start, zero network dependencies, no invented progress

Evidence, partial sessions, complete/undo/redo and exact reward retention through UI
Park/resume retains note, hours and history
Unchanged config application persists every section after reload
Configuration move/insertion after actual completion persists with same identity
Invalid config rejected without mutation and unsupported URL remains inert
Full backup import/export restores config, progress, archive, notes and legacy balance
Legacy save discovery and confirmed migration preserve original rollback data
Legacy ambiguity remains in recovery until explicitly mapped
Failed localStorage write reports failure, preserves previous save, exports pending and retries
Failed config persistence does not replace active configuration or claim success
Malformed stored data is not silently overwritten; explicit fresh recovery retains raw bytes
Storage read denial gives recovery UI instead of silently starting a saved session
Previous-snapshot restoration is available after configuration changes
Bulk UI completion has reversible events; Side Quests and Academy award exact XP
Project targets remain distinct from saved achieved results; task and retrospective edit persist
All ten sections reachable at 390px with touch emulation and no horizontal overflow
320px narrow layout and simulated 200% text sizing preserve all section access
Dialog keyboard trap, Escape, focus restoration and reduced viewport scroll access
